comment: Stubbs is a good professor, but the class was super boring and hard to sit through.

PEACE AND BLESSINGS! Stubbs is so kind-hearted and understanding if you need help or an extension he will work with you and change the syllabus to help accommodate everyone -- you have to buy a lot of expensive books but honestly, you can get by with just skimming them can be boring at times but overall it is worth it to take his class!

This class has 8 books, but you can do fine with just a skim if even that. I didn't get much out of this class because it felt repetitive and slow-paced. It includes a lot of participation and a few papers, none of which were extremely exciting to write. But the professor is so kind and inspiring with lots of wisdom to share about his experiences.

I hope you & your loved ones are doing well. Dr. Stubbs is super chill and simply doing a bit of research on each attorney makes the class conversations simple and easy. The writing assignments are kind of boring, but overall assignments are not difficult. He will NOT respond to your emails, but is accessible at the end of class. Peace & Blessings!

Professor Stubbs is a law professor here but he teaches FYS for first years which shows his commitment to education.  He is extremely caring and understanding and as long you read a little you will be fine for his FYS.  He's not a particularly hard but not easy grader.  He is extremely insightful and a wonderful connection to have if you want law.
Peace and Blessings. He is awesome.
show up and participate a lot and you will get a very good grade, very good teacher, really cares, show you care

He's a really nice guy with clear devotion to law and human rights. The books he assigns are long, boring, and alike. The discussions in class are similar. Don't have to fully pay attention truthfully. The essays are a drag but could be worse. Just have comments on the hw readings. He gives B+ or A- typically
Great professor. He's so nice and really cares about his students. Would take this fys again just to spend more time with Stubbs he's that awesome.

Great professor - came out of the class as a more logical, clearer thinker and writer. He gives everyone the same feedback, almost word for word, as if he's trying to play mind games with the class and create the illusion that everyone is on the same level. I think the chief reason he does this is to encourage everyone to focus on their progress.

In his FYS, Professor Stubbs was captivating, insightful, encouraging, and, above all, a terrific mentor. He has taught me so many things that are outside the scope of law - such as how to be a clearer, stronger writer, how to be a better communicator, and also how to accept other viewpoints and consider them wholeheartedly. Definitely recommend!
